xBRIEFInfo.description: Tier-1 cherry-pick: dry-run version-skew headline for #3437. File-level planning stays on #3462. Do not close #3437.

narratives.Description: Consumer honesty only: deft update --dry-run must lead with deposit-manifest vs content-package version skew when they disagree. Independent cherry-pick from halted PR 3453. File-level planning (planned_paths / planned_file_count / strategy) waits on #3462. Do not close #3437.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer, I want --dry-run to say 'manifest X -> content Y' when those versions disagree, so I am not told the tree is current immediately before a 1,585-file rewrite.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. In emitDryRunPlan (or a thin equivalent that does not call collect-only / planRefreshDeposit / applyRefreshMutations) read recorded deposit version vs content package version. 2. When they disagree, print that skew as the first dry-run line. 3. JSON: previous_version, content_version, deposit_refresh_pending. 4. Do not emit strategy, planned_paths, or planned_file_count. 5. CHANGELOG [Unreleased]. 6. PR Refs #3437, not Closes. Prior art: halted PR 3453 reads only.
narratives.Origin: Dispatch envelope for #3437 tier-1; comments: triage 2026-08-17 and design follow-up #3462. Consumer issue remains open.

items.title: Skew is the first dry-run line

narrative.Acceptance: Given deposit manifest 0.78.0 and content package 0.103.0, when --dry-run prints human output, the first line reports the skew as manifest 0.78.0 -> content 0.103.0. Given matching versions, that headline is omitted.
